      Work log
      
      
    

    

    

      
      
      
      
      
      
      
    

    

    

    

      
      
    

  





How this fits together. Updates is what each morning’s scan turned
up, newest day first, men above women and within each sex sorted by country, agency and name —
whoever the boards published, with no height gate at the scan — narrow it here instead.
A dashed card is a first sighting, still waiting to be seen a second
time before it counts. Directory is every model on every readable board. Photographs cannot be shown
on this page: a published page is not allowed to load images from another site, and every portfolio
picture lives on the agency’s own server. Each arrival therefore carries a photo chip that
opens the agency’s own picture in a new tab, and the morning file — which is not a published
page and so has no such limit — leads every card with the photograph itself. Lumen is everyone you have lit, green above amber — private to your ID. Communicatus is the shared room: every ID’s lamps, and who lit which.
Everything you open on this page is kept in the work log on the right — once a day.
Open the same model again tomorrow and it is filed again under tomorrow, so the log reads as a
day-by-day record: you can see that you looked at a face yesterday and came back to it today.
The badge beside a name counts how many times you opened it that day, and the row keeps the
date you first saw it. Every agency with a model in the log
folds open over them, each already lit, whether or not you ever opened that agency by hand;
its name unfolds the row and the arrow beside it opens the agency’s site.


Green — interested in booking
Amber — pending, still deciding
Red — ruled out, does not fit the criteria
Click a lit lamp again to clear it. Marks follow the model, not the tab, and the
Interest filter narrows either list to just those.
